{{Top|leg}}
'''TransVere''', short for '''transponder verification''', was a process enacted by [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] officials to check a [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] [[Transponder code/Legends|transponder code]] against the records held in the [[Bureau of Ships and Services/Legends|Bureau of Ships and Services]] databank. TransVere was performed when ships arrived and left spaceports.<ref name="PSG">''[[Platt's Smugglers Guide]]''</ref>
